questions.question:
Select the option that indicates the correct arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Carpet

2. Ceiling

3. Bed

4. Floor

5. Fan
questions.solution:
The correct arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order.

First we need to create the **floor** of any room of the building. Then we apply **carpet** on it. Once this is done we will apply **bed** on the carpet. Then we will add **fan** in the room. Last we will make **ceiling** in the room to complete.

Thus, the order of the arrangement in logical way is '**4, 1, 3, 5, 2**'.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All ships are boats.

Some ships are cargo.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some boats are cargo.

II. All boats are ships.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
According to the given statements, we get the Venn diagram as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b327db7497dd2e21db083c70d53c6f831b0649885cf35054ca3accfac4e98652.png] 

Let's check the conclusion as

I. Some boats are cargo.→ **Follow** (Since all ships are boats and some ships are cargo, thus some boats are cargo is true).

II. All boats are ships. → **Doesn't follow **(Since given all ships are boats, and so some boats are ships, but not all. This is not true).

Thus, the **only conclusion I** **follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is "**option (2)"**.

questions.question: Seven children, P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V are seated around a square dining table, all facing towards the centre. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides of the table. One seat is left vacant. U and T are immediate neighbours. Q is seated at a corner, third to the right of T. Only three kids are seated between U and Q. R is an immediate neighbour of both P and Q. P is not an immediate neighbour of T. S is seated second to the left of T. If V is seated fourth to the right of P, where is the vacant seat?

options.text: Fourth to the left of Q
Third to the right of T
To the immediate left of V
Second to the left of R

questions.solution:
Let's arrange the given information in a sequence;

1) Q is seated at a corner, third to the right of T. Only three kids are seated between U and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47faec95e128b7e965edcb3bcc6b9484b9f449f447b1d728b4b282cf55d34b54.png] 

We place Q at a corner and then place T third to the right of Q. Now we place U such that there are only three kids between U & Q.

2) R is an immediate neighbour of both P and Q. P is not an immediate neighbour of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fda9d7230f0f9ff283f826cb1c84d6c9073fce3d93c5e661495081d54f0561df.png] 

We place R such that is becomes immediate neighbor of P and Q also we cannot place P next to T.

3) S is seated second to the left of, V is seated fourth to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ce58ef18ed33ea7943f89e07eb99d8874ad9c9de394999adc371d05a11dc509.png] 

We place V fourth to the right of P & then place S to the second left of V.

From the diagram we can see that vacant seat is second to left of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4. [IMAGE: https://onedrive.live.com/?cid=8FF69A385933D217&id=8ff69a385933d217%21574&parId=8ff69a385933d217%21129&o=OneUp] **

questions.question:
If A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×‘, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

99 D 9 B 6 D 3 A 5 B (2 C 1) A 3 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd29459a0486bcd620718f5e1f54daacd656d5bae3d58440124ead19c52e5fec.png] 

Let's decode the letters:

 
 

 Letters
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 A
 +
 
 

 B
 ×
 
 

 C
 -
 
 

 D
 ÷
 
 

Given:

99 D 9 B 6 D 3 A 5 B (2 C 1) A 3 =?

Substituting the values and solving using BODMAS rule;

⇒ 99 ÷ 9 × 6 ÷ 3 + 5 × **__(2 - 1)__** + 3

⇒ __**99 ÷ 9**__ ×__** 6 ÷ 3**__ + 5 × 1 + 3

⇒ __**11 × 2**__ + __**5 × 1**__ + 3

⇒ __**22 + 5 + 3**__

⇒ **30**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (4)"**.

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are seven cousins of different ages. A is younger than only E. G is younger than C but older than D. B is the youngest amongst them. F is younger than D. D is younger than how many people?
questions.solution:
Given,

A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are seven cousins of different ages.

__ > __ > __ > __ > __ > __ > __ 

1) A is younger than only E.

2) B is the youngest among them.

**__E__** > **__A__** > __ > __ > __ > __ > __**B**__

3) G is younger than C but older than D.

4) F is younger than D.

**C > G > D > F**

__E__ **>** __A__ **>** **__C__** **>** **__G__** **>** **__D__** **>** **__F__** **>** __B__ 

According to the arrangement, D is younger than 4 persons.

Hence, the correct answer is** "option(4)".**
